cases.purpose: When the credential drop fails in the dispatch child of a root cron daemon (setuid and setresuid refused with EPERM by a seccomp filter), each failing child terminates with exit status 127, observed as exit_group(127) at a user-notification listener, the command never runs and the root row is unaffected.
cases.oracle: Kernel-reported exit_group arguments of every process under the filter (system-sequence.py --notify exit_group --log-args exit_group=0), the injected failure being a real EPERM from the same seccomp filter; row output files show which commands ran.
cases.comparison: Exact stdout: the number of exit_group(127) notifications (one per failing row) and per-row ran/identity lines.
cases.script:
P=$PWD
H=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers
cat > "$P/passwd.fx" <<'X'
root:x:0:0:root:/root:/bin/bash
alice:x:3001:3001:Alice:/tmp/parity-case/home-alice:/bin/bash
bob:x:3002:3002:Bob:/tmp/parity-case/no-such-home:/bin/bash
X
cat > "$P/group.fx" <<'X'
root:x:0:
alice:x:3001:alice
bob:x:3002:
staff:x:4000:alice
wheel:x:4001:alice,bob
ops:x:5000:
X
/usr/bin/mount --bind "$P/passwd.fx" /etc/passwd || echo "MOUNT-FAIL passwd"
/usr/bin/mount --bind "$P/group.fx" /etc/group || echo "MOUNT-FAIL group"
/usr/bin/mkdir -m 755 "$P/home-alice"
snap() { local l; set -f; while IFS= read -r l; do case $l in Uid:*|Gid:*|Groups:*|NoNewPrivs:*) echo $l;; esac; done < /proc/$BASHPID/status; set +f; }

/usr/bin/mkdir -m 777 "$P/out"
w=$P/cw
/usr/bin/mkdir -p "$w/etc" "$w/cron.d" "$w/spool" "$w/mail" "$w/jobout"
cmd() { printf '{ /usr/bin/id -u; /usr/bin/id -g; /usr/bin/id -G; echo "$USER $LOGNAME $HOME"; } > %s/out/%s.txt' "$P" "$1"; }
{
  printf '%s\n' 'SHELL=/bin/bash' 'PATH=/usr/bin:/bin'
  printf '* * * * * alice %s\n' "$(cmd alice)"
  printf '* * * * * bob %s\n' "$(cmd bob)"
  printf '* * * * * root %s\n' "$(cmd root)"
} > "$w/etc/crontab"
cat > "$P/poll.sh" <<X
w=$w
export TZ=UTC
BASHCRON_SPOOL_DIR=\$w/spool BASHCRON_OUTPUT_DIR=\$w/jobout BASHCRON_ETC_DIR=\$w/etc BASHCRON_CROND_DIR=\$w/cron.d BASHCRON_MAIL_DIR=\$w/mail BASHCRON_NOW_EPOCH=1700000040 cron run --once
echo "\$1 poll rc=\$?"
X
show() {
  local f=$P/out/$1.txt l=() line
  [[ -f $f ]] || { echo "$1 ran=no"; return; }
  while IFS= read -r line; do l+=("$line"); done < "$f"
  if [[ $1 == root ]]; then echo "$1 uid=${l[0]} gid=${l[1]} env=${l[3]}"; else echo "$1 uid=${l[0]} gid=${l[1]} groups=${l[2]} env=${l[3]}"; fi
}

SS=$H/system-sequence.py
/usr/bin/python3 "$SS" --errno setuid:EPERM --errno setresuid:EPERM --notify exit_group --log-args exit_group=0 --log "$P/exits.jsonl" -- "$BASH" --noprofile --norc "$P/poll.sh" injected
n127=0; nall=0
while IFS= read -r l; do [[ $l == *'"exit_group"'* ]] || continue; nall=$((nall+1)); [[ $l == *'"arg0": 127,'* ]] && n127=$((n127+1)); done < "$P/exits.jsonl"
echo "exit_group-notifications>=3=$([[ $nall -ge 3 ]] && echo yes || echo no) exit_group(127)-count=$n127"
show alice; show bob; show root
/usr/bin/head -c 300 "$P/exits.jsonl" > "$P/exits.sample"
cases.stdout:
injected poll rc=0
exit_group-notifications>=3=yes exit_group(127)-count=2
alice ran=no
bob ran=no
root uid=0 gid=0 env=root root /root
